name: gleaner
description: Your Gleaner task ledger in Claude: list, add, tick off, drop, snooze and edit items, read your notes, and brief you on a project.
long_description: Connects Claude to Gleaner, the service on your Raspberry Pi that turns handwritten reMarkable notes into a task ledger. The tools call Gleaner's API on the Pi with a token of their own, so the Pi keeps the one record and its change log shows what Claude changed. Needs this computer to reach the Pi: on the home network, or over Tailscale.

tools.name: list_items
tools.description: Items in the ledger: open (default), snoozed, closed or all, optionally one project tag

tools.name: create_item
tools.description: Add a task, merged into an open one that is the same task

tools.name: update_item
tools.description: Close, drop, reopen or snooze an item, or edit its text, due date, person or assignee

tools.name: open_loops
tools.description: The open items as Gleaner's markdown summary

tools.name: get_notes
tools.description: Transcribed notes for a day or a range

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: Projects from the registry, with counts of open, waiting and overdue items

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: One project's briefing: open items, waiting, decisions, questions, recent pages and closes

tools.name: get_health
tools.description: Whether Gleaner on the Pi is working: alerts, jobs, sign-in, spend, memory, disk

gleaner_url.title: Gleaner address
gleaner_url.description: Gleaner on your Pi, e.g. http://umbrel:3717 over Tailscale or http://umbrel.local:3717 at home.

gleaner_token.title: Gleaner token
gleaner_token.description: A token from the Pi: token add claude-home --scopes read,write,create --sensitivity all
